title: Sagek Prime
extract:
Sagek Prime is a standalone Prime automatic sidearm used by ancient Orokin Era  Grineer soldiers. Despite its near-nonexistent Status Chance, Critical Hits from the Sagek Prime have a chance for its next shot to apply 5 Status Effects.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Critical Hits have a 6% chance to set the next shot's Status Chance to 500%.
The effect is triggered separately for each bullet when using Multishot, as well as each enemy hit with Punch Through.
Whether an enemy hit via Punch Through can be subject to the increased status chance depends on whether or not the previous enemy hit was critically hit, not whether the previous shot did.
Chance remains until landing another successful shot; missed shots will not reset the chance.
Set status chance ignores all other modifiers, whether from mods or Warframe abilities.
Even though the 500% chance inflicts 5 procs, it does not trigger  Secondary Encumber more than once.
Innate one  and one  polarities.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high crit chance (30.00%)
Above average burst DPS (435.98)
Above average sustained DPS (345.19)
Very high magazine size (75)
Very high ammo pickup (60)
Very high ammo max (450)
High fire rate (12.33 attacks/sec)
High crit multiplier (2.20x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low damage per shot (35.36)
Low total damage (26)
Low accuracy (1.50° to 11.50°)
Very low status chance (1.00%)
Very low disposition (●●○○○ (0.80x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Sagek Prime's main and component blueprints are obtained from Rotation A of The Perita Rebellion, available after completing The Old Peace quest.
Alternatively Sagek Prime's blueprints can be purchased from Roathe in La Cathėdrale, Sanctum Anatomica for  Maphica obtained in The Descendia. Each component blueprint requires 25 and the main blueprint requires 35, totaling 85 Maphica for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Crafting
Sagek Prime's materials are obtained from The Perita Rebellion. A total of 1,400  Agnovidisc, 380  Laudavi, and 175  Servoris are needed to craft both parts.

Notes
The parts cannot be sold for  Orokin Ducats.
Both  Galariak Prime and  Sagek Prime only appear in Duviri AFTER obtaining the weapons. (Bug?)

Trivia
The Sagek Prime's passive ability is essentially the opposite of the Gotva Prime's passive ability.
Despite having Prime in the name, Baro Ki'Teer will not interact with the player as he would if you had primes equipped.
